text.name: TextDesc2
text.text: Released in 2004, Doom 3 was a reimagining of id Software's classic first-person shooter built on the new id Tech 4 engine. The game focused on detailed environments, real-time lighting, and atmospheric horror while revisiting the events of the original Doom. It introduced advanced rendering techniques including dynamic per-pixel lighting and normal mapping. Doom 3 later received expansions, ports, and community modifications that extended its lifespan on modern systems.
